name: Retinol
summary: Vitamin A that speeds up cell turnover. Start slow, use at night.

name: Retinal
summary: One step closer to retinoic acid than retinol, so it works faster.

name: Retinyl Palmitate
summary: A gentle retinoid ester. Mild and slow.

name: Hydroxypinacolone Retinoate
summary: A newer retinoid that tends to be less irritating.

name: Adapalene
summary: An acne-focused retinoid sold over the counter.

name: Tretinoin
summary: Prescription-strength retinoid.

name: Bakuchiol
summary: Plant extract often used as a gentler retinol alternative. Not a retinoid.

name: Glycolic Acid
summary: The smallest AHA. Exfoliates the surface for glow and texture.

name: Lactic Acid
summary: A gentler AHA that also hydrates.

name: Mandelic Acid
summary: A large, slow AHA. Good for sensitive skin.

name: Salicylic Acid
summary: Oil-soluble exfoliant that gets into pores. Good for blackheads.

name: Betaine Salicylate
summary: A milder BHA alternative to salicylic acid.

name: Gluconolactone
summary: A PHA. Gentle exfoliation that also hydrates.

name: Lactobionic Acid
summary: A PHA with antioxidant benefits.

name: Papain
summary: Papaya enzyme that dissolves dead skin gently.

name: Citric Acid
summary: Usually just adjusts pH at tiny amounts. Not an exfoliant here.

name: Ascorbic Acid
summary: Pure vitamin C. Brightens and protects, but it's acidic and unstable.

name: 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid
summary: A stable vitamin C derivative.

name: Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate
summary: A stable, gentle vitamin C derivative.

name: Magnesium Ascorbyl Phosphate
summary: A stable, gentle vitamin C derivative.

name: Ascorbyl Glucoside
summary: A stable vitamin C derivative.

name: Tetrahexyldecyl Ascorbate
summary: Oil-soluble vitamin C derivative.

name: Niacinamide
summary: Vitamin B3. Helps oil, redness, pores and the skin barrier.

name: Azelaic Acid
summary: Calms redness and helps with breakouts and dark spots.

name: Benzoyl Peroxide
summary: Kills acne bacteria. Drying and can bleach fabric.

name: Sulfur
summary: Old-school acne spot treatment.

name: Tranexamic Acid
summary: Fades dark spots and discoloration.

name: Alpha-Arbutin
summary: Fades dark spots.

name: Kojic Acid
summary: Fades dark spots. Can irritate some skin.

name: Copper Tripeptide-1
summary: Copper peptide for firmness and repair.

name: Palmitoyl Pentapeptide-4
summary: Signal peptide for firmness.

name: Acetyl Hexapeptide-8
summary: Peptide marketed for expression lines.

name: Water
summary: The base of most formulas.

name: Glycerin
summary: Pulls water into skin. A cheap, excellent hydrator.

name: Sodium Hyaluronate
summary: Hyaluronic acid salt. Holds water in skin.

name: Butylene Glycol
summary: Light humectant and solvent.

name: Propanediol
summary: Light humectant and solvent.

name: Urea
summary: Hydrates. At high % it also softens rough skin.

name: Snail Secretion Filtrate
summary: Snail mucin. Hydrating and soothing.

name: Panthenol
summary: Pro-vitamin B5. Soothes and hydrates.

name: Allantoin
summary: Soothes and softens.

name: Centella Asiatica Extract
summary: Cica. Calms irritated skin.

name: Madecassoside
summary: Purified compound from centella. Calming.

name: Bisabolol
summary: From chamomile. Calming.

name: Avena Sativa Kernel Flour
summary: Colloidal oatmeal. Soothes itchy, dry skin.

name: Tocopherol
summary: Vitamin E. Antioxidant that also stabilizes formulas.

name: Ferulic Acid
summary: Boosts and stabilizes vitamin C.

name: Resveratrol
summary: Antioxidant from grapes.

name: Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract
summary: Green tea. Antioxidant and calming.

name: Ceramide NP
summary: A skin-identical lipid that repairs the barrier.

name: Ceramide AP
summary: A skin-identical lipid that repairs the barrier.

name: Ceramide EOP
summary: A skin-identical lipid that repairs the barrier.

name: Cholesterol
summary: Barrier lipid that works with ceramides.

name: Phytosphingosine
summary: Ceramide building block.

name: Squalane
summary: Lightweight oil that mimics skin's own.

name: Dimethicone
summary: Silicone that smooths and locks in moisture.

name: Petrolatum
summary: The strongest occlusive. Seals moisture in.

name: Butyrospermum Parkii Butter
summary: Rich, softening plant butter.

name: Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride
summary: Light emollient from coconut.

name: Simmondsia Chinensis Seed Oil
summary: Jojoba oil. Close to skin's own sebum.

name: Cetearyl Alcohol
summary: A fatty alcohol that thickens. Not drying, despite the name.

name: Cetyl Alcohol
summary: A fatty alcohol that thickens. Not drying, despite the name.

name: Zinc Oxide
summary: Mineral UV filter. Broad spectrum.

name: Titanium Dioxide
summary: Mineral UV filter, mostly UVB.

name: Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane
summary: UVA filter.

name: Octocrylene
summary: UVB filter that also stabilizes avobenzone.

name: Homosalate
summary: UVB filter.

name: Ethylhexyl Salicylate
summary: UVB filter.

name: Bis-Ethylhexyloxyphenol Methoxyphenyl Triazine
summary: Modern broad-spectrum filter.

name: Cocamidopropyl Betaine
summary: Mild foaming cleanser.

name: Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate
summary: Gentle cleanser common in syndet bars.

name: Sodium Laureth Sulfate
summary: Foaming cleanser. Milder than SLS.

name: Sodium Lauryl Sulfate
summary: Strong foaming cleanser. Can strip and irritate.

name: Fragrance
summary: Undisclosed scent blend. A common trigger for sensitive skin.

name: Linalool
summary: Fragrance compound and known allergen.

name: Limonene
summary: Citrus fragrance compound and known allergen.

name: Citronellol
summary: Fragrance compound and known allergen.

name: Geraniol
summary: Fragrance compound and known allergen.

name: Lavandula Angustifolia Oil
summary: Lavender oil. Smells nice, can irritate.

name: Alcohol Denat.
summary: Drying alcohol. Fine low in the list, rough near the top.

name: Methylisothiazolinone
summary: Preservative with a high allergy rate.

name: Phenoxyethanol
summary: The most common preservative. Well tolerated.

name: Ethylhexylglycerin
summary: Preservative booster and light conditioner.

name: 1,2-Hexanediol
summary: Humectant that also helps preserve.

name: Sodium Benzoate
summary: Food-grade preservative.

name: Potassium Sorbate
summary: Food-grade preservative.

name: Xanthan Gum
summary: Thickener.

name: Carbomer
summary: Gel thickener.

name: Sodium Hydroxide
summary: Adjusts pH. Fully neutralized in the formula.

name: Disodium EDTA
summary: Keeps minerals from destabilizing the formula.
